summary: CR-045 Reverse Push Frontend Adoption tested against live master (RID 809, bhole chature) and outlet (RID 689, Kunafa Mahal). Frontend behavior is CORRECT for all UI-scope phases (1a/1b/1c/1f/1g PASS). Phase 1d (full-bundle default POST from wizard) FAILS with 'Reverse push failed' surfaced via reverse-error testid because the BACKEND POST /api/proxy/v2/franchise/reverse-push/from/689 returns HTTP 500 when body includes stock_items (implicit in full bundle) or when enforce_child_lock=true. Phase 1e merge-by-name semantics VERIFIED via module subset (categories alone): the POS returns inserted=0, updated=23, failed=0 — so merge-by-name IS working on the backend. Every non-stock_items module (categories, foods, addons, sub_recipes, ingredients, recipes, stock_item_categories) returns 200 with updated>0, inserted=0 — proving a prior pull already ran (this deploy is NOT in a first-ever-pull state as review request assumed).

critical.issue: HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' when module list contains 'stock_items'. Because the wizard default (leave-all-unchecked = pull-everything) omits modules and lets the POS run the full 8-module bundle, this 500 propagates as 'Reverse push failed' in the UI. This is the ROOT CAUSE of Phase 1d failure.
HTTP 500 when enforce_child_lock=true is sent (even with a small module list). So enabling the Enforce Child Lock checkbox in the wizard also breaks the pull.

minor.issue: Preview breakdown reports child_matched=0 across all modules (source=23/0/98/10/105/97 with behind=+23/+98/+10/+105/+97) even though the POST endpoint successfully finds and updates the same-name records (updated=23/98/10/105/97 on curl). The GET form is not merging-by-name for the preview counts, so Phase 1c preview always shows every source item as 'behind' regardless of central state. Frontend renders whatever the API returns — this is a backend/form-data bug.

integration_issues.issue: The default wizard flow (no modules selected → send omitted modules field) always fails because the backend crashes on stock_items. Frontend correctly surfaces via reverse-error testid, but Phase 1d cannot be completed with the current backend. Consider: (a) frontend workaround — always send explicit modules list excluding stock_items until backend is fixed, or (b) wait for backend fix.

Status chip reverse-status-stale='Stale'. All 6 module checkboxes present with counts (categories:23, foods:98, addons:10, ingredients:105, sub_recipes:0, recipes:97). Enforce-lock checkbox (reverse-enforce-lock-checkbox) present. Total: 348 at outlet · 13 already at central · 335 to pull. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/phase1c_wizard_preview.png

PHASE_1d_baseline_pull.evidence: Clicked reverse-next-btn → reverse-push-confirm visible → reverse-confirm-btn → 'Reverse push failed' via reverse-error testid. Backend POST returns HTTP 500 (verified via curl). No reverse-push-results rendered. Screenshot: not captured — dialog stayed on error state. ROOT CAUSE: backend stock_items handler 500s (see backend_issues.critical).

PHASE_1e_merge_by_name.evidence: Re-opened wizard: status chip became 'reverse-status-partial' (changed from 'stale', proving state moves after category-only pull ran). Selected only reverse-module-categories, executed → reverse-push-results shows reverse-result-row-categories: Inserted=0, Updated=23, Failed=0. THIS PROVES merge-by-name works. Also curl-verified for foods (updated=98), addons(10), ingredients(105), recipes(97), stock_item_categories(70), sub_recipes(0). Full-bundle test blocked by Phase 1d backend bug. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/phase1e_ui_categories_pull.png

PHASE_1f_forward_push_regression.evidence: Clicked push-btn-689 as master. No console errors captured. Store row still present after operation. Existing forward push flow unaffected by Pull button addition.

PHASE_1g_expand_row_regression.evidence: Clicked name cell in store-row-689 (not the Pull button — e.stopPropagation works). store-detail-689 renders with STORE INFO, STOCK HEALTH (48 OOS / 8 Low / 49 Adequate), PUSH HISTORY, and CATALOGUE POLICY card (policy-card-689). No console errors. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/phase1g_expanded.png

curl_backend_probes.note: Direct proxy calls with master token, all against /api/proxy/v2/franchise/reverse-push/from/689

action_items: Backend team: fix the reverse-push 'stock_items' module handler — it 500s in isolation and blocks the default (no-modules) full-bundle path. Frontend feature is unusable in its default configuration until this is fixed.
Backend team: fix reverse-push handling when enforce_child_lock=true is set — currently 500s regardless of module list.
Backend team: fix GET reverse-push-form breakdown — child_matched is reported as 0 even when POST successfully merges same-name records. Preview counters are misleading.

Frontend team (optional workaround): Consider explicitly filtering out 'stock_items' from the default modules payload in api.js reversePushFromChild until backend is fixed. Or expose stock_items as an opt-in checkbox in the wizard.

Frontend team (nice-to-have): When reverseError contains the string 'Internal Server Error' or backend returns 500, show a more actionable message (e.g., 'Backend error — please contact ops or try a smaller module set').

Main agent: Phase 1d cannot be re-verified via UI until backend is fixed. Merge-by-name semantics (the core CR-045 QA question) are CONFIRMED WORKING via curl and per-module UI test — no frontend change needed for that.
critical_code_review_comments: StoreManagement.jsx L432: two-condition gate `isTopLevel && child.restaurantTypeFlag === 'franchise'` correctly implemented and verified — no need for a feature flag as spec dictates.
StoreManagement.jsx L437: e.stopPropagation() correctly prevents Pull button click from bubbling to row-expand handler. Verified in Phase 1g — chevron click still expands row.

ReversePushWizardDialog.jsx: all documented data-testids present and accurate (dialog, preview, status-<state>, module-<label>, enforce-lock, next-btn, confirm-btn, back-btn, loading, results, result-row-<module>, done-btn, cancel-btn, error). No missing selectors.

api.js L970-983 reversePushFromChild: 'omit modules to push everything' semantics are correct per spec, but this default path is what triggers the backend 500. Consider a safer default until backend fix.

Preview merge-by-name display bug: ReversePushWizardDialog.jsx L127-142 renders behind = source - child_matched. The BACKEND returns child_matched=0 for all modules despite same-name records existing (proved via POST merge-by-name). This makes the '+23' 'behind' badges misleading — actually 0 will be inserted. Not a frontend bug per se, but consider adding a tooltip clarifying that final counts may differ post-merge.

rca_of_the_issue: Phase 1d root cause: the POS-backing endpoint POST /v2/franchise/reverse-push/from/{childId} throws when handling module 'stock_items' OR when enforce_child_lock=true. When the wizard is executed with the DEFAULT selection (no modules ticked → API called with body {push_food_bundle:true, enforce_child_lock:false} = 'pull everything'), the backend implicitly runs all 8 modules including stock_items and 500s the entire response. Frontend error handling is correct (reverseError → reverse-error testid → 'Reverse push failed'). Isolated module POSTs (categories, foods, addons, sub_recipes, ingredients, recipes, stock_item_categories) all return 200 with proper merge-by-name (inserted=0, updated=N). Two-gate visibility (isTopLevel + franchise) works flawlessly.
